# PdfAConformance

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

PDF/A archival-conformance level for the document.

Orthogonal to [`AccessibilityMode`](accessibility-mode.md) in storage, but the two interact: "a" (accessible) levels presuppose tagged output, so selecting `PdfA1a`, `PdfA2a`, or `PdfA3a` requires `settings.accessibility = AccessibilityMode.PdfUa1`. PDF/A-4 baseline has no legacy `a`/`b`/`u` conformance suffix. The serializer enforces this at save time.

"b" (basic) levels guarantee visual reproducibility only - they do not require structure tagging and so are the safe upgrade path for documents that have not yet adopted PDF/UA-1.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Values

- `None`: No PDF/A claim. Default. The document is a normal PDF.
- `PdfA1b`: PDF/A-1b (ISO 19005-1:2005, conformance B). PDF 1.4 visual fidelity.
- `PdfA1a`: PDF/A-1a (ISO 19005-1:2005, conformance A). PDF/A-1b + tagging.
- `PdfA2b`: PDF/A-2b (ISO 19005-2:2011, conformance B). PDF 1.7-based; modern baseline.
- `PdfA2a`: PDF/A-2a (ISO 19005-2:2011, conformance A). PDF/A-2b + tagging.
- `PdfA3b`: PDF/A-3b (ISO 19005-3:2012, conformance B). PDF/A-2b + embedded files (ZUGFeRD basis).
- `PdfA3a`: PDF/A-3a (ISO 19005-3:2012, conformance A). PDF/A-3b + tagging.
- `PdfA4`: PDF/A-4 (ISO 19005-4:2020 baseline). PDF 2.0-based archival output. Attachments are dropped.
- `PdfA4f`: PDF/A-4f (ISO 19005-4:2020, conformance F). PDF/A-4 that carries attachments of any type. The document must have at least one attachment.
